entities.summary: Asia Mohammed Tom Taher Al-Katiabi, also known as Asia Abdelmajid, was a Sudanese theatrical actress and teacher. She was one of Sudan's first professional actors and received acclaim for her stage performances. She was the widow of the poet Muhammad al-Fayturi and was killed in crossfire during the war in Sudan on 3 May 2023.
